paragraphs: In the morning, models attend a fitting and align on the styling direction. At midday, they enter the studio, rehearse movements and angles, and coordinate lighting with the photographer. In the afternoon, they shoot a set of product images and repeatedly adjust the emotional tone. In the evening, they rush to a runway rehearsal and update their portfolio between bookings.
